market.summary: Large caps rose for a second day but small and mid caps sold off: Nifty +0.51% to 23,053 while the Smallcap 100 fell 1.85% and the Midcap 100 0.93%. IT led after Cognizant's results; consumer durables (-1.78%) and media (-1.46%) were the weakest sectors, which touches Orient Electric and Tips. Brent stays near $113 on US-Iran tension, and US tech futures were sharply lower in the evening, so Monday could open soft. For these holdings the drag is the small-cap selling, not company news.

points.text: Sensex +308 (+0.42%) at 74,459.53; Nifty +116 (+0.51%) at 23,053.10; Nifty gained about 2% on the week.
Nifty Midcap 100 -0.93%, Smallcap 100 -1.85%; India VIX up about 2%.
Nifty IT +2.3% and Pharma +1.55% led; Consumer Durables -1.78% and Media -1.46% lagged.
Brent about $113 a barrel on US-Iran tensions; Nasdaq 100 futures were down about 2.4% during Indian evening hours.
Global screen at 21:00 IST (intraday): S&P 500 -1.2%, Nasdaq -2.2%, VIX +8.8%, USD/INR 94.94.

market.watch: Whether the US tech sell-off holds into Friday's US close; small-cap breadth on Monday.

points.text: Volume 14.18 million shares vs 11.91 million the day before; delivery 66%.
Last exchange filing is still the 16 Oct call transcript; no bulk / block / short deals in 10 days.

GROWW.watch: A close under 188.75 is the exit; back above 200.80 puts the trade in profit.

points.text: Close Rs 773.45 vs average Rs 884.13 and stop Rs 838.03: -2.40R (-12.5%).
